title: "WGS_CNV_ORA_Reactome_Pathway"
output: html_document
date: "2026-03-02"
---

```{r}
# Reactome ORA Using 273 Genes that have altered CN profiles (Genome-wide Background)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(org.Hs.eg.db)
  library(ReactomePA)
  library(enrichplot)
  library(ggplot2)
})

# ====================================================
# Define paths
# ====================================================
CNV_DIR <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WGS/PCGR/Downstream/CNV"

all_unique_file <- file.path(CNV_DIR, "ALL_unique_genes.tsv")

all_unique_genes <- read.delim(all_unique_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# =========================================
# Prepare 273 gene list
# =========================================

genes_273 <- unique(all_unique_genes$SYMBOL)

cat("[INFO] Total CNV genes (input):", length(genes_273), "\n")

```
```{r}
# =========================================
# SYMBOL -> ENTREZ mapping
# =========================================

map273 <- suppressMessages(
  bitr(
    genes_273,
    fromType = "SYMBOL",
    toType   = "ENTREZID",
    OrgDb    = org.Hs.eg.db
  )
)

mapped_entrez_273 <- unique(map273$ENTREZID)

cat("[INFO] Mapped to ENTREZ:", length(mapped_entrez_273), "of", length(genes_273), "\n")
```
```{r}
# =========================================
# Reactome ORA (Genome-wide background)
# =========================================
# Get only protein-coding genes
gene_info <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys = keys(org.Hs.eg.db, keytype = "ENTREZID"),
  columns = c("ENTREZID", "GENETYPE"),
  keytype = "ENTREZID"
)

all_entrez_ids <- gene_info %>%
  dplyr::filter(GENETYPE == "protein-coding") %>%
  dplyr::pull(ENTREZID) %>%
  unique()

cat("[INFO] Universe size (protein-coding only):", length(all_entrez_ids), "\n")

er_273 <- enrichPathway(
  gene          = mapped_entrez_273,
  universe      = all_entrez_ids,
  organism      = "human",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
  qvalueCutoff  = 0.25,
  readable      = TRUE
)

if (is.null(er_273) || nrow(as.data.frame(er_273)) == 0) {
  stop("No significant Reactome enrichment detected.")
}

res_df_273 <- as.data.frame(er_273) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(p.adjust)
```

```{r}
# =========================================
# Print annotation coverage (ANY pathway)
# =========================================

reactome_universe <- unique(er_273@universe)

genes_in_reactome_any <- intersect(mapped_entrez_273, reactome_universe)

cat("\n====================================================\n")
cat("[INFO] Reactome annotation coverage (273 genes)\n")
cat("====================================================\n")
cat("Input genes:", length(mapped_entrez_273), "\n")
cat("Annotated in Reactome:", length(genes_in_reactome_any), "\n")
cat("Not annotated:", length(setdiff(mapped_entrez_273, genes_in_reactome_any)), "\n")
```
```{r}
# =========================================
# Print top pathways
# =========================================

cat("\n[TOP REACTOME TERMS]\n")

print(
  res_df_273 %>%
    dplyr::select(ID, Description, GeneRatio, Count, pvalue, p.adjust) %>%
    head(10)
)
```
```{r}
# =========================================
# Save results
# =========================================

# ---- Save enrichment table ----
out_tsv <- file.path(CNV_DIR, "Reactome_ORA_genomeBG_all273.tsv")
write.table(res_df_273, out_tsv, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)

# ---- Save high-resolution PNG ----
p <- dotplot(er_273, showCategory = 15) +
  ggtitle("Reactome ORA (Genome-wide background) — All CNV genes (n=273)")

print(p)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(CNV_DIR, "Reactome_ORA_genomeBG_all273_dotplot.png"),
  plot = p,
  width = 10,
  height = 10,
  dpi = 300
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(CNV_DIR, "Reactome_ORA_genomeBG_all273_dotplot.pdf"),
  plot = p,
  width = 10,
  height = 10
)
```
```{r}
# Reactome ORA (Genome-wide background) - Recurrent CNV genes (n=66)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(clusterProfiler)
  library(org.Hs.eg.db)
  library(ReactomePA)
  library(enrichplot)
  library(ggplot2)
})

# ====================================================
# Define paths
# ====================================================

CNV_DIR <- "/ix1/alee/LO_LAB/Personal/Rahul/pILC/WGS/PCGR/Downstream/CNV"

recurrent_file <- file.path(CNV_DIR, "recurrent_genes_min5.tsv")

recurrent_genes_5 <- read.delim(recurrent_file, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# =========================================
# Prepare recurrent 66 gene list
# =========================================
genes_66 <- recurrent_genes_5$SYMBOL %>%
  as.character() %>%
  str_trim() %>%
  unique()

cat("[INFO] Recurrent CNV genes (input):", length(genes_66), "\n")

# =========================================
# SYMBOL -> ENTREZ mapping
# =========================================
map66 <- suppressMessages(
  bitr(
    genes_66,
    fromType = "SYMBOL",
    toType   = "ENTREZID",
    OrgDb    = org.Hs.eg.db
  )
)

mapped_entrez_66 <- unique(map66$ENTREZID)
mapped_symbols_66 <- unique(map66$SYMBOL)

cat("[INFO] Mapped SYMBOLs:", length(mapped_symbols_66), "of", length(genes_66), "\n")
cat("[INFO] Unique ENTREZIDs:", length(mapped_entrez_66), "\n")

unmapped <- setdiff(genes_66, mapped_symbols_66)
if (length(unmapped) > 0) {
  cat("[WARN] Unmapped symbols (showing up to 30):\n")
  print(head(unmapped, 30))
}
```
```{r}
# =========================================
# Reactome ORA (Genome-wide background)
# =========================================
# Get only protein-coding genes
gene_info <- AnnotationDbi::select(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys = keys(org.Hs.eg.db, keytype = "ENTREZID"),
  columns = c("ENTREZID", "GENETYPE"),
  keytype = "ENTREZID"
)

all_entrez_ids <- gene_info %>%
  dplyr::filter(GENETYPE == "protein-coding") %>%
  dplyr::pull(ENTREZID) %>%
  unique()

cat("[INFO] Universe size (protein-coding only):", length(all_entrez_ids), "\n")

er_66 <- enrichPathway(
  gene          = mapped_entrez_66,
  organism      = "human",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
  qvalueCutoff  = 0.25,
  readable      = TRUE
)

if (is.null(er_66) || nrow(as.data.frame(er_66)) == 0) {
  stop("[ERROR] No significant Reactome enrichment detected for recurrent 66 genes.")
}

res_df_66 <- as.data.frame(er_66) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(p.adjust)

```

```{r}
# =========================================
# Print annotation coverage (ANY Reactome pathway)
# =========================================
reactome_universe <- unique(er_66@universe)
genes_in_reactome_any <- intersect(mapped_entrez_66, reactome_universe)

cat("\n====================================================\n")
cat("[INFO] Reactome annotation coverage (recurrent 66)\n")
cat("====================================================\n")
cat("Input genes (ENTREZ):", length(mapped_entrez_66), "\n")
cat("Annotated in Reactome:", length(genes_in_reactome_any), "\n")
cat("Not annotated:", length(setdiff(mapped_entrez_66, genes_in_reactome_any)), "\n")

# Optional: list not-annotated SYMBOLs
missing_entrez <- setdiff(mapped_entrez_66, genes_in_reactome_any)
if (length(missing_entrez) > 0) {
  missing_symbols <- map66 %>%
    dplyr::filter(ENTREZID %in% missing_entrez) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(SYMBOL) %>%
    dplyr::pull(SYMBOL)
  cat("\n[INFO] Symbols not annotated in Reactome:\n")
  print(missing_symbols)
}
```
```{r}
# =========================================
# Print top pathways
# =========================================
cat("\n[TOP REACTOME TERMS]\n")
print(
  res_df_66 %>%
    dplyr::select(ID, Description, GeneRatio, Count, pvalue, p.adjust) %>%
    head(10)
)

# =========================================
# Save results
# =========================================
out_tsv <- file.path(CNV_DIR, "Reactome_ORA_genomeBG_recurrent66.tsv")
write.table(res_df_66, out_tsv, sep = "\t", quote = FALSE, row.names = FALSE)
p <- dotplot(er_66, showCategory = 15) +
  ggtitle("Reactome ORA (Genome-wide background) — Recurrent CNV genes (n=66)")

print(p)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(CNV_DIR, "Reactome_ORA_genomeBG_recurrent66_dotplot.png"),
  plot = p,
  width = 10,
  height = 10,
  dpi = 300
)

ggsave(
  filename = file.path(CNV_DIR, "Reactome_ORA_genomeBG_recurrent66_dotplot.pdf"),
  plot = p,
  width = 10,
  height = 10
)
```
